segments.caption: A sunny, tree-lined street is filled with a large crowd of people walking and standing along the sidewalks and road, suggesting a festive parade or public event. Palm trees and large leafy trees line the street, with buildings visible on the left and spectators gathered on both sides. The scene is lively and bustling, with people of all ages moving forward, indicating a community gathering or celebration in progress.

A sunny, tree-lined street is filled with spectators lining the sidewalks, watching a parade of motorcyclists ride down the road. The crowd, including families and individuals, stands and watches as the motorcycles pass by, creating a lively, festive atmosphere under clear blue skies.

A sunny street parade unfolds, with spectators lining the sidewalks under large trees, watching and recording as a procession of motorcyclists and cyclists moves past. The crowd, casually dressed, is engaged and attentive, capturing the event with phones and cameras as the riders pass by.
A sunny street parade unfolds under palm and leafy trees, with a crowd lining the sidewalks and motorcyclists, including police officers, riding in formation down the road.
A crowd of people gathers on a grassy median beside a tree-lined street, watching as a Beverly Beach police SUV with flashing lights drives past, indicating an ongoing police presence or incident.
A police car with flashing lights drives down a tree-lined street as a crowd of onlookers gathers on the sidewalk and grass, observing the scene.

A police car with flashing lights drives down a tree-lined street crowded with spectators, who are watching and recording a parade or procession of vehicles, including motorcycles and a large truck, moving in the opposite direction.

A lively parade unfolds down a sun-dappled street lined with palm and large trees, with a black pickup truck serving as the main float, carrying people waving from its bed. Spectators line the sidewalks, cheering and waving back, while a scooter and other vehicles follow behind. The bright, clear day and the energetic crowd underscore the festive, communal nature of the event.

A lively street parade unfolds under bright sun, with a black pickup truck serving as a moving platform for fans, including a man in a “Schultz 55” Los Angeles Kings jersey waving to the crowd. Spectators line the sidewalks and grassy areas, cheering and recording the event on their phones as the truck drives past, capturing the energetic, celebratory atmosphere of a public fan gathering.

A lively street parade celebrates a sports victory, featuring players in black and white jerseys riding atop vehicles, waving to cheering crowds, and prominently displaying a large championship trophy.

A person sits atop a vehicle, triumphantly holding a large trophy aloft as a crowd of onlookers gathers on the street, many raising their phones to capture the celebratory moment under bright, sunny skies.

A crowd of people gathers on a sunny street, many holding up phones to record as a black pickup truck drives slowly past, its driver and passengers visible. The scene is framed by large trees and parked cars, and a police officer in a blue helmet appears in the foreground, suggesting an official or public event is underway.

A group of men are gathered on a residential street, engaging in a lively, possibly celebratory, interaction. Two men in LA Kings jerseys stand on the roof of a white pickup truck, holding red cups, while others stand on the sidewalk, gesturing animatedly. A police officer in a blue helmet is visible in the foreground, observing the scene. A crowd of people gathers on a sunny street, enthusiastically cheering and filming as a white pickup truck drives by, with fans standing on its bed waving and celebrating.

A lively street parade unfolds under bright sun, featuring a white pickup truck with fans in Raiders jerseys riding on its bed, a large white flag with a crown emblem waving proudly, and a procession led by a red fire truck and a police car, all moving along a tree-lined avenue with spectators lining the sidewalks.

A lively street parade unfolds under a bright, sunny sky, lined with palm trees and bustling with spectators. Emergency vehicles, including a Manhattan Beach Fire Department truck and a police car, escort a large group of cyclists riding down the street. Crowds of people on the sidewalks and in the street watch and cheer, capturing the festive, community-oriented atmosphere of the event.
